periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oriented approximately 45 degrees downward and outward from the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-teardrop shape with a higher vertical-to-horizontal ratio at the outer edge.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point extending significantly below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Relatively broad, shallow U-shape curvature at the posterior boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick, comprising approximately 20-25% of the visible dorsal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between ears, roughly equivalent to the width of an individual pinna.
